game.name: bw
game.description: Four-player OpenBW StarCraft: Brood War free-for-all over the bitworld sprite protocol. Each slot picks its own race. Build an army, eliminate the other players, and be the last one standing within 45 minutes.

tokens.description: One connection token per player slot.

race.description: Race for this slot; terran when omitted.

players.description: One display-name object per player slot.

maxTicks.description: Game frames before the episode ends.

num_agents.description: Seat count for the episode. The ruleset commissioner reads this to size episode rosters; the game itself ignores it (seats are the tokens array).

scores.description: Per-slot FFA score. Victory dominates, followed by surviving army and economy value.

marines.description: Living Marines per player slot at episode end.

barracks.description: Living Barracks per player slot at episode end.

outcomes.description: OpenBW victory state per player slot.

supplyDepots.description: Living Supply Depots per player slot at episode end.

mineralsGathered.description: Total minerals gathered per player slot.

player.name: Sleepy Terran
player.description: Uses a one-barracks opening, produces Marines, and attacks rotating enemy start locations.

player.name: Lazy Terran
player.description: Neutral baseline: keeps its starting SCVs mining and never trains, builds or attacks. Use it as a punching bag opponent.

player.name: Sleepy Zerg
player.description: Zerg swarm for a slot with race zerg: morphs Drones and Overlords from Larvae, builds a Spawning Pool and extra Hatcheries, expands to the corner minerals, and sends Zergling waves through the gate walls.

player.name: Sleepy Protoss
player.description: Two-Gateway Zealot build for a slot with race protoss: warps Pylons and Gateways, expands to the corner minerals, and sends Zealot waves through the gate walls.

variants.name: Four-player FFA
variants.description: Four players on Weave fight to be last standing within 10 minutes. Each slot may set its own race; slots default to Terran.

variants.name: Four-player Protoss FFA
variants.description: All four slots are Protoss. A race-specific policy cannot choose its own race — race comes from this config — so a Protoss bot dispatched into the raceless standard variant is handed a Terran base it cannot build from. This mirror lets Protoss bots compete on equal terms. Longer than standard because every base is sealed behind a 4000 HP neutral wall, and breaking out plus killing three bases does not fit in 14400 ticks.

variants.name: Four-player Zerg FFA
variants.description: All four slots are Zerg. Same purpose as the Protoss mirror: a race-specific policy needs a config that grants it its race.

variants.name: Four-player Terran FFA
variants.description: All four slots are explicitly Terran. Same shape as the other mirrors so the set is symmetric; matches what the standard variant produces by default, but stated rather than implied.

commissioner.name: BW Commissioner
commissioner.description: Runs recurring four-player FFA rounds and ranks policies by mean placement score.
